details.report: Forward commit d8b4205 streams Pi-v3 parsing and chain validation directly into a compact lifecycle collector instead of retaining all JSONL rows; synchronizes shipped manifest/failure v2 schemas with runtime; removes the two ADR-0016 format-only tests; adds minimal custom lifecycle and compactness oracles; and rebuilds shipped Recorder dist. Existing production transaction, invocation, extraction/admission, publication, package, and stream-forwarding owners were censused and retained where already correct. Verification: focused Recorder tests passed (16/16); typecheck passed; build passed; full suite passed (295 pass, 5 skip); npm pack --dry-run passed; git diff --check passed. No Souls, legacy transport, active-stream hooks, retry/topology mechanisms, or out-of-scope issues were changed.
